Partly.description: true is left out of boolean; "a", which string admits by its kind, is not, with a warning on it.

PartlyNull.description: null is left out; "a" and "b" are not, with a warning on each.

PartlyRef.description: null is left out of the member that lists it, not of the reference, which may admit it.

MaybeNull.description: A schema that admits null among other values.

NestedIf.description: A $ref is resolved in a not that is ignored, but not in an if inside it, which is not read.

TwoViews.description: A warning in a schema of two types is reported once.

Labels.description: unevaluatedProperties with nothing beside it to evaluate is additionalProperties; the warning is where it is.
